subject: Business
title: Category Creation: Make Your Own Market
description: A short lesson to help you apply Category Creation: Make Your Own Market.

hook.text: Salesforce didn't enter the CRM market. It created 'cloud CRM' and made on-premise software look obsolete.

buildup.text: Category creation means defining a new market space and positioning yourself as the obvious leader.

discovery.text: The creator of a category captures 76% of the total market value, according to Harvard Business Review.

twist.text: Creating a category is expensive. You must educate the market, which means paying for everyone's awareness.

climax.text: HubSpot coined 'inbound marketing' and built a billion-dollar business by owning the category it invented.

punchline.text: Don't win an existing category. Create one and own it.

quiz.question: What percentage of market value does a category creator typically capture?

details.summary: Category creation builds an entirely new product or service category rather than competing in an existing one. The company that defines a new category often becomes its dominant leader because first-to-define advantage shapes customer and analyst perception of the entire space.
details.whyItMatters: Category creators capture disproportionate market value. Research shows category kings take up to 76% of total category market capitalization. Creating the category lets you define the rules competitors must play by.
takeaways: Defining a new category gives the creator outsized market share and valuation
Category design requires simultaneous product, company, and market development
Successful category creation changes how customers think about a problem

faq.question: How does category creation differ from product differentiation?
faq.answer: Differentiation competes within an existing category on features or price. Category creation defines an entirely new space with new buying criteria. Salesforce did not just make better CRM software; it created the cloud software category, changing how buyers evaluated solutions.

faq.question: What are the risks of trying to create a new category?
faq.answer: Educating a market is expensive and slow. The category might not materialize if customer demand is insufficient. Fast followers may co-opt the category after you invest in education. Timing must align with customer readiness to adopt a new way of thinking.
